body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view.
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below is a RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through** (RimWorld input is welded to Find.CurrentMap). The plumb (identity x/z) transform makes a shared "swap CurrentMap around one input op" scope viable for passive/one-shot interactions; selection (in-place, no jump) and orders (stair routing) keep bespoke semantics; multi-frame drags are the hard part.
- Logistics doctrine (pass 32, anti-carousel): every ferry MONOTONE (storage moves = exactly vanilla with capacity clamp; demand pulls shortfall+retention-backed via PinnedByNativeNeed; in-flight ledger; timer import pin only as storage-move grace).
- Needs-bridge doctrine: postfix vanilla giver, re-run guard chain, probe linked levels with SAME finder, one-hop stairs job, per-pawn cooldowns.
- Work-migration hysteresis (pass 32): post-arrival commitment cooldown (version-bump-immune), arrival-tick recharge, version bumps only for level-linked maps.

## REMOVED FEATURES (postmortems preserved)
**SKYLIGHTS (round 7)** — postmortem pass 16. **MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12)** — removed per user; revisit dossier pass 22.

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement (USER) · Batch A (USER) · bug-wave fixes (USER): mech charge crash gone, bill supply + mech RMB.

# PASS 33 — SEE-BELOW INPUT PARITY (in progress)

## User reports (this pass)
1. From the sky view, right-clicking a DBH water well (and buildings generally) did nothing. 2. With the elevation lock (End) on, clicking a colonist on the VANILLA colonist bar still changed the camera's elevation.

## Fixes BUILT (green, NOT yet user-verified)
- **RMB building hit-test (root cause via [AB RMB diag]):** `ResolveTargetMap` chose the target level purely from the RAW clicked cell's open-air terrain, so a below building whose cell the cursor rounded off never redirected (log showed targetL=sky on every well click). Added `BelowSelection.TryBelowRightClickCell` — render-aware hit-test (nearest visible pawn by rendered center, else visible building/item in cursor cell or its 8 neighbours) — and the RMB prefix snaps clickPos onto that below thing's cell before ShouldRedirect. Only refines when the cheap test would NOT already resolve below (open-air clicks pay nothing). This is GENERIC: DBH etc. flow through vanilla FloatMenuOptionProvider_FromThing + WrapOptions routing, NO per-mod patch.
- **Elevation lock GroundMap hardening (root cause hypothesis):** `ShouldSuppressJump` decides same-column via `Map.GroundMap()`; if the sky map's `groundMap` field is ever null (old save / out-of-gen-context / unrestored scribe ref) it returned null and the lock failed OPEN. RMB kept working because it keys off lowerMap/level directly — exactly matching "RMB works, lock doesn't." `GroundMap()` now walks the vertical links when the field is null (bounded by 3-level cap). Hardens SameColumn + 2-hop RMB too.
- **TEMP dev diagnostics still in the build:** `[AB RMB diag]` (redirect decision + clicked cell + sky terrain + below buildings + generated option labels) and `[AB lock diag]` (lock suppress decision). Prefs.DevMode-gated. STRIP once both fixes are user-verified.

## Test-run #147 findings
`[AB RMB diag] NO redirect: ... curL=1 targetL=1 selMapL=1` on every well click confirmed the raw-cell target resolution bug. No `[AB lock diag]` lines emitted (lock case not exercised yet). ~60+ unrelated errors, all other mods (Soundscape, CE, Melee Anim, Vehicle Framework, etc.) — none ours.

## INTERACTION AUDIT (vanilla mouse/UI x see-below hook status)
✅ done · ⚠️ partial · ❌ not applied
- **Select:** single/double/shift left-click ✅ (BelowSelection); selection bracket ✅; inspect pane + gizmos of below-selected thing ✅ implicit. **Drag-box select ❌** (SelectInsideDragBox).
- **Info:** **mouseover cell readout ❌** (MouseoverReadout.MouseoverReadoutOnGUI shows sky cell); hover thing labels/tooltips over below ❌.
- **RMB orders (all ✅ via FloatMenuMakerMap+CrossLevelOrders):** single/multi order, building interactions (generic, no per-mod patch), drafted attack/goto, formation drag (ABBelowGotoDrag), stairs travel option.
- **Targeters (✅ CrossLevelTargeting/CrossLevelCombatUI):** melee(H)/ranged(B), ability/psycast, turret/mortar, hover cursor/crosshair. **Non-combat tool targeters ⚠️** (only attack/cast sources; e.g. DBH "connect fixture to bed" not handled).
- **Designators ❌ ALL:** build/blueprint, orders (mine/chop/harvest/deconstruct/smooth/haul/hunt/tame/slaughter/strip), zones (stockpile/growing/dumping), allowed-area, plans, cancel/deconstruct, drag-area (hardest, multi-frame). Workaround: switch view to the level to build/order.
- **Camera:** level view switch ✅; colonist-bar/alerts/letters jump ✅ (elevation lock, GroundMap hardened).

## PROPOSED "see-through" refactor (pending user go-ahead)
1. Unify the duplicated/drifting hit-test into ONE `BelowInput.Resolve()` (map+cell+thing under cursor) — migrate selection/RMB/targeting onto it, killing the drift bug class (RMB-weaker-than-select is that class).
2. Shared input-scope adapter (generalized ABCurrentMapSwap) for cheap wins: mouseover readout + single-cell designators (plumb transform => preview lands at same x/z).
3. Bespoke multi-frame work last: drag-box select, drag-area designate.
OPEN QUESTIONS for user: (a) do designators-through-see-below matter, or is "switch view to build" acceptable? (b) start with hit-test unification + verify well/lock fixes first?

# VANILLA PARITY SCAFFOLD (passes 26-30 done: P0 UI truth, P1 emergency, P2 needs, P3 DLC doers). P4 verify-only backlog stands.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
**0-pre (PASS 33, TOP): (a) right-click a DBH water well / any building from the sky view -> options appear and the pawn routes down to use it. (b) End-key lock ON + click a colonist on another level in the VANILLA bar -> view stays put.** Then strip the temp [AB RMB diag]/[AB lock diag] logs.
Pass-32 queue still pending: log-carousel dead, stair-thrash dead, ferry round-2, P0-P3, pass-31 compat session, below lighting, animal flow, BAM/Batch B/C, perf/CE-absent/translation/soak/publishing, P4 sweep.

## FEATURE LEDGER

## Status
2026-07-25 (33rd pass, IN PROGRESS): See-below INPUT parity. Built (green, unverified): (1) render-aware RMB building hit-test — snaps the click onto the visible below building/item/pawn under the cursor so DBH wells and any building route down (generic, no per-mod patch); root-caused via new [AB RMB diag] showing targetL always = sky. (2) Elevation-lock GroundMap link-walk hardening — fixes the lock failing open when sky.groundMap is null (RMB unaffected because it uses lowerMap directly). Temp dev diagnostics still in build; strip after user verifies. Delivered a full vanilla-interaction x hook-status AUDIT and a proposed "see-through" refactor (unified hit-test + shared input-scope adapter); designators are the big remaining gap. Awaiting user direction on scope + a verification test of the two fixes.
